ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) with localized high-intensity (white) pixel clusters at distal tips; estimated ratio of 85:15 dark to light.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white mottling concentrated at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes and intermittently along the trailing edge boundary.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression dividing the lobes with a sharp interior angle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude variations (serrations) observed along the continuous boundary of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep from the distal tips toward the median notch along the trailing edge boundary.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial clusters of white pixels appearing as localized rosettes at the distal tips of both fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white scarring or pigmentation irregularities localized at the fluke tips and trailing edge margins.
